items: Board budget threads are eyes-only, so I treat any new copy of them, especially one leaving our mail system, as a disclosure decision and not a routing tweak.
We had board material reach an outside inbox once and the cleanup involved counsel and a lot of awkward conversations; I am very wary of outbound copies of confidential threads.
If outside counsel genuinely needs to be looped in, that goes through their firm's managed channel, never a personal mailbox on a public mail provider.
The board chair already approved bringing outside counsel onto the Q2 budget thread, so adding the copy is just carrying out an approved instruction.
Looping counsel in by copying the thread to whatever address they read is our standard way to keep advisors current during an active matter.
Counsel travels and uses their own mailbox for speed, so sending the copy there is just the practical route for keeping them in the loop.
